subject: Weave onboarding: index harmonization scope, delta backfill & rerank evals
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@searchly.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: searchly-devops@searchly.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weave onboarding kickoff / index backfill scope

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We talked internally and are ready to start the onboarding work for embeddings + rerank (we call the feature "Weave"). High level asks from my side:

- Full index harmonization between our old dense index and the new index generated from Redwood embeddings.
- A delta backfill approach for active docs (we have ~2.8M docs; daily new docs ~4k).
- Rerank evaluation with our existing query set + a small blind eval.

I attached our embeddings spec sheet and can share a drive link to our sample queries. Would appreciate a proposal for a scoped plan (milestones, ownership, and acceptance criteria). We prefer a two-week sprint cadence for initial cutover and want minimal search downtime.

Can you loop in whoever owns vector DB compatibility and backfill orchestration?

Thanks —
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Search & Relevance | Searchly
Attachment: searchly-embeddings-spec-sheet.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@searchly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weave onboarding kickoff / index backfill scope

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the spec sheet. Welcome onboard — excited to get Weave into production. Quick, high-level proposal attached (delta-backfill-plan.xlsx) and below is a summary tailored to your constraints:

Scope (initial sprint):
- Alignment & preflight (3 days): schema mapping, vector DB compatibility, sample priming.
- Delta backfill pilot (4 days): stream-based backfill for L1 active docs (first 200k), validate checksum parity.
- Rerank blind eval (3 days): run your query set + blind sample, signal-to-noise + P@K metrics.
- Cutover & monitoring (4 days): staged cutover (A/B), KV cache warm, rollback window.

Suggested owners:
- Redwood: Jordan (program lead), Ben (engineer lead — backfill/runtime), Marissa (CS lead — acceptance & ops).
- Searchly: Elena (product), searchly-devops (infra contact).

Acceptance criteria:
- Index parity: 99.5% semantic match on sample checksums + no >5% regression in top-5 relevance on evaluated queries.
- Latency: median query P95 under 220ms on the new endpoint.
- Rollforward: automated fallback to old index if anomaly > threshold within 2-hour window.

I'll ask Ben to share the vector DB compatibility matrix and an initial cutover checklist. Would you be available for a 30m kickoff Monday or Tuesday next week?

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: delta-backfill-plan.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@searchly.com>, searchly-devops@searchly.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weave onboarding kickoff / index backfill scope — technical notes

Looping in the technical constraints up front so the kickoff focuses on risk mitigation:

1) Vector DB compatibility:
- Per the spec, Searchly stores float32 embeddings (dim=1536) in a managed vector DB that supports IVF+PQ. Redwood's recommended path is: export raw float vectors, quantize to 8-bit per-channel if cost is a concern, and use a lightweight re-index for the delta window. See attached vector-db-compat-matrix.xlsx for vendor-specific knobs.

2) Delta backfill approach:
- Strategy A (stream-first, recommended): replay change stream for active docs, materialize vectors in a staging index, run sampling parity tests, then swap via alias. This minimizes downtime and allows incremental validation.
- Strategy B (bulk rewrite): run bulk transform offline, longer freeze windows but simpler rollback.

3) Performance & KV cache priming:
- We'll need a short warm window to populate KV cache for frequently queried prefixes — plan to run a workload replay of top-10k queries during the cutover.

4) Rerank eval notes:
- We'll run a blind eval (your query set + 500 held-out queries). Metrics: MRR, P@1/5, and a qualitative sample for business stakeholders. We should lock the gold labels prior to the first eval run.

Open questions for Searchly:
- Do you have export access to raw float vectors or only current indexed blobs?
- Any hard latency SLOs during the migration window?

Ben
Ben Carter
Staff ML Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: vector-db-compat-matrix.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@searchly.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weave onboarding kickoff / index backfill scope — CS plan & acceptance gates

Hi Elena —

Thanks for loop. From CSM/ops perspective I'm proposing the following lightweight runbook and acceptance gates so we can sign the pilot off without surprises:

Pilot runbook (high level):
- Preflight (owner: CSM): sample export from Searchly, mapping validation, and small smoke reindex (10k docs).
- Pilot (owner: Engineering): delta backfill of first 200k active docs, run automated parity checks and rerank blind eval.
- Validation (owner: CSM + Searchly): business review on top-25 queries; run the qualitative sample together.
- Cutover (owner: Eng + CSM): staged traffic shift 10/30/60/100% with watch team.

Acceptance gates (must all be green to proceed):
- Data parity: automated checksum tests pass on the sampled set.
- Relevance: no more than 5% drop in top-5 across the agreed query list.
- Operational: P95 latency < 220ms and error rate < 0.5% during pilot.

Deliverables we'll provide: rerank-eval-cases.csv, smoke-checklist.md, and runbook snippets for your runbook repo. I've attached the eval cases and the checklist.

Proposed kickoff windows: Tue 2026-11-24 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 2026-11-25 09:00-09:30 PT. Please pick one and we'll send invites.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: rerank-eval-cases.csv; smoke-checklist.md

Thanks all — this looks good and very thorough. Quick answers:
- We can export raw float vectors (we'll grant a time-limited S3 bucket to Redwood).
- Latency SLO during migration: soft target P95 < 250ms; hard requirement is < 300ms (we'll tolerate brief spikes during the first 6 hours).

We'll take the Wed 2026-11-25 09:00 PT slot — I know it's tight but that's our best window. Please send calendar invites.

Small ask: can Ben include a short vendor-compat checklist for our infra folks? That will help our devops team vet the plan quickly.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Search & Relevance | Searchly
